newsitem.title: CHINA: China reporter kills himself after foiled defection.
newsitem.headline: China reporter kills himself after foiled defection.

text.p: The former Washington bureau chief of China's state-run Xinhua news agency committed suicide just days after he was recalled to Beijing for planning to defect, sources said on Wednesday.
Wei, 47, hanged himself in his home last week while awaiting reassignment, Chinese sources with close links to the agency said.
"There will be a memorial service tomorrow," a source said.
Wei had been recalled from Washington in late March after he was believed to be planning to defect, a source said.

"They started to suspect that he wanted to flee and made him come back to Beijing to give him a new job," the same source said. "We don't know why he committed suicide but we guess it was because he lost face."
Xinhua officials confirmed Wei, who was also deputy director of the agency's international department, had died but declined to elaborate.

The New York Times on Wednesday quoted one of Wei's colleagues as saying a Washington co-worker discovered him preparing documents to support a political asylum application in the United States for himself, his wife and his 17-year-old daughter.
Wei was a specialist on American affairs and served a first tour in Washington from the late 1980s to 1993. He was appointed Xinhua's Washington bureau chief in early 1996, the newspaper said.
